info.title: HiveMind simulated business
info.description: apis of the simulated quick-commerce grocery business. money is integer paise; times are rfc 3339 utc; errors are rfc 9457 problem details. every read carries an evidence_id. every api except the fake sign-in needs a case token (`Authorization: Bearer ...`); the customer comes from that token, never from the url.
